summary: Verified aggregator addon fix (CR-118) and Order Report Beta (CR-117). All 5 features work as expected. During testing, discovered and fixed a critical TDZ (Temporal Dead Zone) crash in AggregatorOrderPopOut.jsx where `settings` was read in useState initializers before `const { settings } = useRestaurant()` was declared — this was crashing the entire dashboard with an ErrorBoundary. After the fix, dashboard loads cleanly and all target features work: (1) aggregator addon '+ Paneer' shows on Schezwan Dosa (Zomato #QW5X9ZIQ), (2) regular POS addons '+ extra cheese slice' and variant 'Large' still render, (3) Order Report Beta at /reports-module/order-report-beta loads with date pickers, KPI strip (Total 9 / Paid 2 / Unpaid 6 / Cancelled 1), filters and 9-row table, (4) Sidebar 'Daily Report' flyout shows 'Orders (Beta)' link.

ui_bugs.issue: TDZ error: `settings` read in useState initializers (lines 59, 61) before its declaration on line 66. Dashboard crashes with 'ReferenceError: Cannot access settings before initialization'. Fixed by moving `const { settings } = useRestaurant()` above the useState calls that reference `settings`.

action_items: Review the AggregatorOrderPopOut.jsx fix (moved useRestaurant destructure above useState) — this was a code-order bug that fully broke the dashboard for accounts with aggregator settings. Please add a lint rule / ESLint no-use-before-define to prevent regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: AggregatorOrderPopOut.jsx: TDZ ordering — const declarations were referenced by earlier useState initializers. Now fixed by reordering. Recommend ESLint no-use-before-define.
OrderCard.jsx addon/variant parser (lines 663-681) is robust: handles multiple shapes ({name,value}, {name,labels[]}, string). Good defensive coding.
aggregatorTransform.js: addon normalization (title→name) + is_variant separation looks correct and clean.
OrderReportBetaPage.jsx (459 lines) — approaching size threshold; consider splitting into <ReportFilters>, <KpiStrip>, <ReportTable>, <ReportFooter> subcomponents for maintainability.
OrderCard.jsx at 1259 lines — well over the 700 line threshold. Should be split into logical subcomponents (header, items, actions, modals) for maintainability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard uses two view modes: Grid (default, shows compact TableCards) and List (data-testid='view-toggle'). To see OrderCard with item-level addon/variant rendering, switch to List View, then click 'Preparing' or 'Ready' tab. Aggregator Zomato order #QW5X9ZIQ with 'Schezwan Dosa + Paneer' addon is a good regression check. Order Report Beta is reachable via Sidebar → Reports icon (data-testid='sidebar-reports') → 'Orders (Beta)' flyout item. Direct URL navigation to /reports-module/order-report-beta from a fresh login gets bounced to /loading — need to log in fully first, then navigate via sidebar or click.
rca_of_the_issue: AggregatorOrderPopOut.jsx: `const [printKot, setPrintKot] = useState(settings?.aggregatorAutoKot ?? false)` on line 59 executed at first render, but `settings` (a `const` from `useRestaurant()`) was declared on line 66 — creating a TDZ. React function components execute the body top-to-bottom on each render, so this always threw. The fix moves `const { settings } = useRestaurant()` above the affected useState declarations. This was likely introduced by CR-118 when adding the checkbox defaults.
